metadata.og:description:
Update: 19/04/2024: read at the end of the post for more info.
I have been trying to pick up Rust again recently. It’s been a bit of a slow burn at the beginning but I think I’m
finally starting to feel the compounding effects kicking in. Maybe it’s just my brain playing a trick on me, but
I’m feeling at much more ease when writing Rust now than I was a few weeks back.
